turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Quick question. How do you get garlic smell off your hands?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Rub them on something stainless steel under cold water, like the side of the sink or a spoon. Then wash with soap.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It does, but plenty of people swear by it. Lemon juice and a little salt also help.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, something else. I'm trying to pick a way to budget because I keep running out of money before payday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I've got loads of these to get through, so bear with me till the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One method is tracking every single purchase in a spreadsheet, which is detailed but takes time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another one is the envelope method, where I take out cash for each category every week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could use a budgeting app that connects to my bank and sorts everything automatically.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The app is the easiest to stick with, since it does the sorting for you. The envelope method is great if you overspend with cards, because you can see the cash running out. The spreadsheet gives the most detail, but it's easy to fall behind on.
